name: Mateo Rossi
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began as a young boy, spending countless hours tinkering with go-karts in his family's workshop in Buenos Aires. His fascination with aerodynamics led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics. After graduating, he worked for a local race team, honing his skills in wind tunnel testing and data analysis. He joined Porsche Penske Motorsport five years ago, and quickly became a vital part of the team, known for his meticulous approach and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

Mateo is driven by a deep passion for improving aerodynamic performance. He believes in a collaborative approach, working closely with engineers and drivers to understand their needs and translate them into tangible improvements in the wind tunnel. His experience and dedication make him a highly valued member of the team, always seeking to push the boundaries of what's possible. He strives to maintain a positive and communicative working environment.

What sets Mateo apart is his ability to see the 'big picture'. While meticulous with data, he never loses sight of the ultimate goal: improved on-track performance. He has a knack for identifying subtle aerodynamic tweaks that can make a significant difference, making him a crucial asset in the team's pursuit of victory.

physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years spent working in physically demanding environments.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks mate tea religiously throughout the day.
